name: Quote Van
tagline: Job quotes tradespeople can send from the driveway
about: Quote Van turns a job description or photo into a priced quote for plumbers, electricians, decorators and builders, and handles variations, deposits and payment terms.
persona: You are an estimator who has run a trades business: fair on labour, realistic on materials and access, and precise about what is excluded.

onboarding.title: Quote it right the first time
onboarding.subtitle: Your trade and rates power every estimate.
bullets: Quotes from a description or photo

tools.title: Build a quote
tools.subtitle: Description → itemised, ready-to-send quote

inputs.label: Job description
inputs.placeholder: replace kitchen mixer tap, isolate, supply tap, dispose of old

tools.prompt: Estimate the job: {job} for {client}, access {access}, using the profile rate and markup. Table (Item | Qty | Unit | Unit price | Line total) split into Labour and Materials, kv (subtotal, contingency, tax note, total, validity in days), a quote with the clean quote text to send including exclusions and assumptions, and a callout on risks to price in or exclude.

tools.title: Estimate from a photo
tools.subtitle: Snap the job, get a range

inputs.label: What the customer wants
inputs.placeholder: fix the leak and retile this corner

tools.prompt: From the photo and the request '{ask}', identify the work needed as bullets, then a table (Task | Hours | Materials | Est. cost) using the profile rate, a callout on what cannot be judged from a photo and needs a site visit, and a quote with a short message to the customer giving a price range.

tools.title: Price a variation
tools.subtitle: They changed their mind mid-job

inputs.label: What changed
inputs.placeholder: they now want underfloor heating and a second shower head

tools.prompt: Price the variation to '{original}': {change}. Table (Extra | Labour | Materials | Total), kv (new contract total, extra days, when the extra payment is due), a quote with a variation-order note for the customer to sign off, and a callout on why not to start the extra work until it is agreed.

tools.title: Deposits & terms
tools.subtitle: Stage payments and plain-English T&Cs
tools.prompt: Set payment terms for a {total} job over {days} days for a {type}: kv (deposit %, stage payments with their triggers, final payment due, late-payment note), a quote with plain-English terms and conditions under 200 words, a checklist of things to get in writing before starting, and a callout on materials-upfront and cancellation basics.

tools.title: Chase a quote
tools.subtitle: Turn a sent quote into a booked job
tools.prompt: Follow up the quote for '{job}', situation: {stage}. A quote with a 60-word text message and a second version as a short email, bullets on what to offer to close (timing, scope trim, payment options, not price cuts), and a callout on when to walk away.

disclaimer: Estimates are guidance, not a substitute for a site survey; contract and consumer-notice rules vary by region.
